chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu Khalid al-Qammat, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who had intercourse with his wife on the Day of Sacrifice before performing Tawaf (Ziyaarah). He (peace be upon him) said: 'If he had intercourse with her with desire, then upon him is a camel; and if it was without that, then a cow.' I said, 'Or a sheep?' He (peace be upon him) said, 'Or a sheep.'

key_terms.يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ: Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: What is the expiation for sexual intercourse during Hajj before Tawaf?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the specific expiation (kaffarah) for breaking the state of Ihram through sexual intercourse with one's spouse before completing Tawaf al-Ifadah. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) distinguishes the penalty based on intent: a camel is required if the act was driven by sexual desire, while a cow suffices if it was not, with the option to substitute a sheep for the latter. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the element of desire (shahwah) in determining the severity of the ritual breach.
